findings.problem: Mi papá e hijo is unnatural and confusing: with one possessive it reads as a single person who is both dad and son, and nobody would say it to mean my dad and my son.
findings.fix: example.es: Hablo español e inglés. example.en: I speak Spanish and English.

back.es: and (form of y used before a word starting with an i sound)
back.example: My dad and son work together. (literal; the Spanish suggests one person who is both my dad and son, or leaves 'son' without an owner)

note: The hint could add that y stays before hie- words (agua y hielo), but that doesn't affect this prompt.
